controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE/CONTRACTUEL : "un accord d'actionnaires AVEC FOX CORPORATION plafonne toutefois cette concentration a 44% des voix de categorie B" (repete en quantitatif #1 : "plafonne contractuellement a 44% ... par l'accord conclu avec Fox Corporation").
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "The Company has entered into a stockholders agreement with LGC HOLDCO AND THE LGC FAMILY TRUSTS pursuant to which the parties have agreed not to take actions that would result in LGC Holdco and the LGC Family Trusts owning, collectively with K. Rupert Murdoch, Lachlan K. Murdoch, Grace Murdoch and Chloe Murdoch (the 'Murdoch Individuals'), more than 44% of the outstanding voting power of the shares of Class B Common Stock (the 'Ownership Threshold'). LGC Holdco and the LGC Family Trusts would forfeit votes to the extent necessary..." Fox Corporation n'est PAS partie a cet accord : le 10-K ne mentionne Fox que pour les administrateurs communs et les opportunites d'affaires. L'erreur est repetee deux fois dans l'ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "un accord d'actionnaires conclu entre News Corp, LGC Holdco et les LGC Family Trusts plafonne a 44% des droits de vote de categorie B la detention cumulee de LGC Holdco, des trusts et des membres de la famille Murdoch nommes ; au-dela, ils renoncent aux voix excedentaires".

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #3 : "un GAIN UNIQUE DE 692 M$ enregistre en 2025 lors de la cession de Foxtel, classee en activites abandonnees".
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Net income from discontinued operations, net of tax for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 was nil compared to $692 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025. The fiscal 2025 amount relates to the reclassification of Foxtel to discontinued operations." Le 692 M$ est le RESULTAT NET TOTAL des activites abandonnees, pas un gain de cession. La Note 3 donne le vrai chiffre : "For fiscal 2025, Other, net primarily consists of the $716 million PRE-TAX GAIN on the sale of Foxtel." Le resultat des activites abandonnees revenant aux actionnaires NWS est par ailleurs de 700 M$, pas 692.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "un gain avant impot de 716 M$ sur la cession de Foxtel, qui porte le resultat des activites abandonnees a 692 M$ en 2025 (700 M$ part du groupe)".

controles.affirmation: "Book Publishing, qui fait aussi face a la CONCURRENCE DE PLATEFORMES D'IA GENERATIVE EMERGENTES SUR LE MARCHE DU LIVRE".
controles.verbatim_source: La seule phrase du 10-K sur la concurrence de plateformes IA emergentes vise un AUTRE segment : "The DIGITAL REAL ESTATE SERVICES segment operates in a highly competitive digital environment with other operators of real estate and property websites and mobile apps, and also faces competition from emerging AI-powered platforms, tools and services." Le paragraphe concurrence de Book Publishing ne parle pas d'IA : "This marketplace is highly competitive and continues to change due to technological developments, including additional digital platforms and distribution channels such as streaming audiobooks, and other factors."
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer cette attribution, ou la deplacer sur le segment Digital Real Estate Services. Pour Book Publishing, le 10-K evoque plutot les partenariats de streaming audio et les accords de licence avec des societes d'IA comme axe strategique, pas comme menace.

controles.affirmation: Emploi repete du terme "IA GENERATIVE" attribue au 10-K (resume, fondamental_externe #1 et #2).
controles.verbatim_source: Le mot "generative" n'apparait AUCUNE fois dans le 10-K FY2026 (0 occurrence, recherche insensible a la casse sur 89 occurrences de "AI"). Le filing ecrit "AI platforms", "AI developers", "AI-powered products and services", "advances in AI".
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "IA generative" par les termes du filing : "plateformes d'IA" et "developpeurs d'IA".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 1 : "34,52% des actions de categorie B detenues par LGC Holdco au 30 juin 2026", programme de rachat de 1 Md$ acheve sur l'exercice, decrit par la societe comme augmentant la part de categorie B de LGC Holdco.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "LGC Holdco beneficially owns less than one percent of the Company's outstanding Class A Common Stock and approximately 34.52% of the Company's Class B Common Stock as of June 30, 2026." ; "The Company's Board of Directors has authorized a $1 billion stock repurchase program for the Company's Class A and Class B Common Stock, which HAS INCREASED and could in the future further increase the percentage of Class B Common Stock held by LGC Holdco." ; "the '2021 Repurchase Program', which was completed during the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026". Classe B = classe votante confirmee : "Holders of the Company's Class A Common Stock are entitled to vote only in the limited circumstances set forth in the Charter. Holders of the Company's Class B Common Stock are generally entitled to one vote for each share held of record." La correction signalee dans _sources sur le champ voting_structure de v2-pipeline est donc justifiee.
controles.correction_proposee: Manque une information materielle : le 10-K signale qu'un NOUVEAU programme de 1 Md$ a ete annonce le 15 juillet 2025 ("2025 Repurchase Program"). L'ATT laisse croire que le rachat est termine, et son item ce_qui_affaiblirait "Un nouveau programme de rachat est annonce sans mecanisme de plafonnement" est deja caduc : le nouveau programme existe, et le plafond de 44% est un accord d'actionnaires independant de tout programme.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 2 : resultat net part du groupe 573 M$ contre 1 180 M$ (-51%) ; resultat des activites poursuivies 648 -> 743 M$ (+15%) ; CA 9 028 M$ (+7%).
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, compte de resultat : "Total Revenues 9,028 8,452 576 7 %" ; "Net income from continuing operations 743 648 95 15 %" ; "Net income attributable to News Corporation stockholders $573 $1,180 $(607) (51)%".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 3 : EBITDA News Media -9% (139 vs 153 M$), Book Publishing -3% (287 vs 296 M$), les deux pesant 4 515 M$ sur 9 028 M$ soit exactement la moitie ; Dow Jones +13% et immobilier numerique +23%.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, tableau segments : Dow Jones 2,497 / 663 contre 2,331 / 588 (+12,8%) ; Digital Real Estate Services 2,016 / 741 contre 1,802 / 601 (+23,3%) ; Book Publishing 2,288 / 287 contre 2,149 / 296 (-3,0%) ; News Media 2,227 / 139 contre 2,170 / 153 (-9,2%) ; Total 9,028 / 1,627. 2 288 + 2 227 = 4 515, soit 50,01% de 9 028.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision : l'ATT ecrit "deux des cinq segments" mais le 10-K n'en publie que QUATRE (le cinquieme, "Other", n'est pas un segment operationnel : revenus nuls et EBITDA de -203 M$). Ecrire "deux des quatre segments operationnels".

controles.affirmation: Tresorerie : 2,0 Mds $ d'emprunts contre 2,1 Mds $ de tresorerie au 30/06/2026 ; 255 M$ non librement accessibles car loges chez REA Group, detenue a 62%.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, bilan : "Cash and cash equivalents $2,095 $2,403" ; tableau des engagements : "Borrowings (c) - 1,031 469 500 2,000" ; "The Company's cash and cash equivalents balance as of June 30, 2026 and 2025 also includes $255 million and $280 million, respectively, which is not readily accessible by the Company as it is held by REA Group Limited, a majority owned but separately listed public company. REA Group must declare a dividend in order for the Company to have access to its share of REA Group's cash balance." ; "its 62.0% interest in REA Group".

controles.affirmation: Dependance aux plateformes tierces : algorithmes de classement, effets deja constates sur la demande et le prix ; revenus digitaux a 76% des revenus de circulation de Dow Jones contre 74%.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "...adversely impacted, and may continue to adversely impact, demand and pricing for the Company's products and services. Third-party platforms like search engines, social media and AI platforms and digital marketplaces ... have significant influence over how the Company's content and other products and services are discovered and displayed. Changes these platforms make to algorithms, ranking methodologies, presentation, placement, user interfaces, access terms or pricing affect the Company's ability to attract, retain and monetize consumers..." ; "Digital revenues represented 76% of circulation revenue for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, as compared to 74% for fiscal 2025." Menace PI : "Unauthorized use, including in the digital environment and as a result of advances in AI, presents a threat to revenues from products and services based on intellectual property ... third parties, including AI developers, may scrape, crawl or otherwise exploit the Company's content ... without authorization."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le filing parle d'une menace sur "revenues from products and services based on intellectual property", formulation plus large que "notamment les revenus de licences" retenue par l'ATT.
